half_b_proof_run.deviation: The literal exit-0 acceptance criterion does not hold. Root cause, fully traced: verify-meaning.py's changed_files() runs `git diff --name-only BASE` against the current worktree/HEAD with no path scope, so EVERY changed .md file since BASE enters the scan, not only the landing's docs-only commits. `git log 8de413aa..HEAD -- .planning/STATE.md .planning/WINDOWS.md` shows exactly one commit, 9086c705 (plan 154-02's own SUMMARY+STATE+ROADMAP+WINDOWS close-out) -- ordinary GSD workflow bookkeeping, not part of the landing and not a corpus-meaning change. D-28's assumption ('with BASE = the pre-merge SHA and the landing's docs-only commits, no planning file is in range') is falsified by the same root cause already logged as WINDOWS.md #9 for plan 154-02's Task 1 precondition: ordinary GSD close-out sequencing (task commits -> SUMMARY/STATE/ROADMAP/WINDOWS commit) makes any BASE captured before a prior plan's own close-out commit see that close-out's .planning/ changes in every subsequent worktree-diffing tool run. This is NOT a corpus-meaning defect: independently confirmed zero of the 9 findings land on any docs/ file outside the six _DISPOSITIONS.tsv already covers, and the 6 docs/ findings are fully and correctly dispositioned. VERIFY-01's actual deterministic-meaning-preservation guarantee over docs/ is proven; the literal 'exit 0' wording is not met due to this plan-authoring gap, per the same precedent already established for the Task 1 precondition (not re-litigated, not fixed by adding path scoping -- prohibited -- or by editing the 6-row dispositions file to 9 rows, which would break the '_DISPOSITIONS.tsv's six reasons only' contract). Flagged for 154-04's amendment sweep alongside WINDOWS.md #9.
